school_name: State University of New York at Cortland
title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Ten documented no-cost places and activities on campus or in the Cortland area.

cards.title: Explore Bowers Science Museum
cards.subtitle: Bowers Hall, SUNY Cortland
cards.notes: Walk through the lobby exhibits on fossils, rocks, chemistry and physics, then spend time with the digital planetarium displays.
cards.short_summary: A campus science museum with natural-history and interactive exhibits.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland states that Bowers Science Museum is open to the public and free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Open to students, faculty and campus visitors; confirm current building access before visiting.

cards.title: See an exhibition at Dowd Gallery
cards.subtitle: Dowd Fine Arts Center, SUNY Cortland
cards.notes: Drop into the gallery to view the current exhibition, or attend an accompanying artist talk, lecture, performance or workshop.
cards.short_summary: Campus gallery presentations and related programs are publicly accessible.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland says all Dowd Gallery exhibitions and programs are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Walk-ins are welcome; the gallery is closed when the university is not in session.

cards.title: Browse Memorial Library’s print collections
cards.subtitle: Memorial Library, SUNY Cortland
cards.notes: Meet up for a quiet browse of the print collections or settle into a reading session with materials available on the premises.
cards.short_summary: A campus library option that welcomes the general public for on-site print resources.
cards.evidence_claim: SUNY Cortland’s borrowing policy says Memorial Library is open to the general public and that print resources are accessible to all on the premises.
cards.access_notes: On-site print-resource access is public; electronic databases and computer labs have separate eligibility rules.

cards.entity_name: Use WiFi at Cortland Free Library
cards.title: Connect at Cortland Free Library
cards.subtitle: Cortland Free Library, 32 Church Street
cards.notes: Bring a device and use the LibraryPublic network in the building or on the library grounds for a low-key shared work session.
cards.short_summary: Password-free library WiFi available around the building and grounds.
cards.evidence_claim: Cortland Free Library states that WiFi is available 24/7 in the building and on library grounds, with no password needed.
cards.access_notes: Observe the library’s Internet and Computer Use Policy while connected.

cards.title: Borrow a book, movie or game
cards.subtitle: Cortland Free Library, 32 Church Street
cards.notes: If you live in the Finger Lakes Library System region, bring identification and address proof to get a card and borrow together.
cards.short_summary: Eligible regional residents can borrow physical and digital materials at no charge.
cards.evidence_claim: Cortland Free Library says eligible Finger Lakes Library System residents may get a card for free and use it to borrow books, music, movies and more for free.
cards.access_notes: Free-card eligibility requires regional residence plus proof of ID and address; temporary residents have a separate card process.

cards.title: Take a free swim at Yaman Beach
cards.subtitle: Yaman Park, Cortland
cards.notes: Plan a daytime summer swim and bring what you need for the beach; use the posted seasonal operating window as your guide.
cards.short_summary: A city-listed free swimming facility at Yaman Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Cortland lists Yaman Beach among its free swimming facilities.
cards.access_notes: The city lists Yaman Beach hours as 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.; verify seasonal availability before going.

cards.entity_name: Swim at C. C. Wickwire Pool
cards.title: Swim at C. C. Wickwire Pool
cards.subtitle: Suggett Park, Cortland
cards.notes: Gather a friend for an afternoon pool session at Suggett Park and check the city schedule before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A city-listed free swimming facility in Suggett Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Cortland lists C. C. Wickwire Pool at Suggett Park as a free swimming facility.
cards.access_notes: The city lists Wickwire Pool hours as noon to 7 p.m.; verify seasonal availability before going.

cards.entity_name: Walk the trails at Lime Hollow Nature Center
cards.title: Walk Lime Hollow’s trails
cards.subtitle: Lime Hollow Nature Center, 338 McLean Road
cards.notes: Choose an easy, moderate or difficult route, download or pick up a trail map, and make the outing fit your group’s pace.
cards.short_summary: No-charge trails with multiple difficulty options near Cortland.
cards.evidence_claim: Cortland County’s activity guide lists Lime Hollow Nature Center trails as having no charge.
cards.access_notes: The county guide notes that trail maps are available online or at the nature center.

cards.entity_name: Walk the East End Community Center indoor track
cards.title: Walk the East End indoor track
cards.subtitle: East End Community Center, 46 Elm Street
cards.notes: Use the indoor track for a casual walking lap with a friend, signing in at the center before you start.
cards.short_summary: A no-charge indoor walking option in Cortland.
cards.evidence_claim: Cortland County’s activity guide lists the East End Community Center indoor track as no charge.
cards.access_notes: The county guide lists access Monday through Friday, 11:30 a.m. to 2:30 p.m., with sign-in at the center.

cards.title: Walk the Bennett Street Field trails
cards.subtitle: Bennett Street Field, McGraw
cards.notes: Head to the trails around the soccer field for an easy nearby walk, keeping the route social and at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: No-charge walking trails around McGraw’s soccer field.
cards.evidence_claim: Cortland County’s activity guide lists walking trails around the soccer field at Bennett Street Field as no charge.
cards.access_notes: Listed at Bennett Street Field on Elm Street Extension in McGraw.
